children: Shares of CPI Card Group slipped after it disclosed that certain shareholders of the payments company commenced an underwritten secondary offering of its common stock.
The stock fell 15%, to $22.80, after hours Thursday. It finished regular trading down 4.6%, at $26.94.
The stockholders, affiliated with Parallel49 Equity, are offering some 2.3 million shares of CPI's common stock. The company has a public float of 6.05 million shares.
CPI isn't offering any shares of common stock in the offering, and all proceeds would be received by the selling shareholders.
